exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Have to/Must".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～なくちゃいけない matches "Have to/Must".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～なくちゃいけない.
exercises.explanation: Expresses obligation or necessity; means "have to" or "must" do something.
